_comment: The graphs inside core's `collab` sub-graph, declared FROM WITHIN (#980) on the pattern of `dsa/graph.json`. Each entry is `subgraph: true`, a directory of the LAYER listed by `resolveDirectories` with `within: "collab"`. Paths are relative to THIS directory. OPT-IN (`optIn: true` on its entry), and it `requires` `cat-harness.sdlc` (owner, 2026-11-13): off in every layer unless that layer lists `folio-assistant-core.collab` in its own `enableSubgraphs`.
name: collab

directories.description: The content processes that run on the work plan and the delivery process, and their callers, in the concern groups `conduct`, `content` and `library` as under `processes/`, with the decision tables they evaluate.

Tool definitions that serve only collaborative development, one folder per Tool (`tools/<id>/<id>.ts`, as in core's own `tools/`): `folio-block-screenshots`, which satisfies `visual-diff` (cat-harness's `sdlc`).
